newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion to restructure preclinical R&D.
newsitem.headline: Orion to restructure preclinical R&D.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals maker Orion-Yhtyma Oy said on Tuesday it would cut about 30 jobs in its Orion Pharma unit's preclinical research activities, but would not change total R&D expenditure.
Pre-clinical research is research conducted ahead of clinical trials.
Orion said in a statement its research activities would be increasingly directed towards market-oriented development projects.

"Those operations in research areas, mainly in the early stages of preclinical research, which are progressing slowly and/or offer unsatisfactory profit expectations will be reduced," Orion said in a statement. @
"At this stage approximately 30 persons will be given notice of termination," it said.
"Resources will be shared in a better way in R&D operations without changing the total volume of R&D expenditure," the company said.
Orion Pharma's expenditure on research and development was 280 million markka in 1995, or 16.9 percent of pharmaceuticals net sales, it said.
Its R&D operations employ about 700 people, it said.
